mapper.insert: insert into conversation_turn (session_id, seq, user_text, assistant_text, audio_path, latency_ms) values (#{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{userText}, #{assistantText}, #{audioPath}, #{latencyMs})
mapper.select: select id, session_id, seq, user_text, assistant_text, audio_path, latency_ms, created_at, updated_at from conversation_turn where session_id = #{sessionId} order by seq desc limit 1
